label: D2 after choosing a1, or after an unrewarded previous trial (strongest)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO), on 35% of D2 steps. It has two parts with very different magnitudes. (1) Weak, broad firing at D2 whenever this trial chose a1 (58% of a1-D2 steps vs 16% of a2-D2 steps); D2 & a1 & previous trial rewarded covers 81-88% of the bottom two activation quartiles but only 32% of the mass. (2) Strong firing at D2 when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0 covers 91% of the top quartile, 67% of the mass), largest during runs of unrewarded a1/S1 trials. The union D2 & (a1 | prev_reward==0) has recall 0.985 and mass recall 0.995, but precision is only 0.53: many such steps stay silent, depending on history that I could not capture. Adding choice logit < 3 at D2 (choice not strongly for a1) lifts dev F1 from 0.69 to 0.74, but I recorded the simpler version. All variables are observed at D2. It does not fire after a rewarded a2 trial, and it never fires at D1 or GO.
